requirement.summary: KDS2.0 - Show status color horizontal line for each course in ticket
requirement.description:
Existing Behavior:

There is a grey and horizontal line with 3 pixles above each course to separte other courses in all tickets

Enhancement:

It is requested to show status color in horizontal line for each course to represent the latest status of the course.

Acceptance Criteria:

The horizontal line should follow the earliest status within the course, same as the behavior of ticket status. If two items in Starters, item A is fire staus, item B is Completed, the line should be in fire color.

requirement.summary: TMS2.0-Switch to traditional Chinese login and a blank page appears.
requirement.description:
Steps To Reproduce:

1. Go to Login View, input Login Name and Passwoed, click Login button.

2. Select Outlet, switch to traditional Chinese, click Continue button.

Expected Result:

- The page is displayed normally.

Actual Result:

- A blank page displayed.
